focus: Prove or refute that the existing ENERGY-REMAP-11 candidate's Bayesian hard-reset gate can ever fire under its frozen per-row sample quota.
original_code_identity: marginalMapRows computes stay=logDM(new_count, old_count+0.5), reset=logDM(new_count,0.5), resetProb = exp(log(.25)+reset - logsumexp(log(.75)+stay, log(.25)+reset)); candidate uses flag=resetProb>=.8.
hypothesis: With six OLD categorical observations and two NEW categorical observations per row, the maximum possible Bayes factor in favor of a new-row reset versus a pooled-row prediction is 15/2=7.5, so the maximum posterior reset probability with prior reset=1/4 is 5/7<4/5; hence the proposed hard reset is mathematically impossible for every world and mapping, not only the 36 observed worlds.
method: Use exact integer arithmetic and enumerative counts over all C(11,5)=462 nonnegative OLD count vectors summing to 6, each paired with all C(7,5)=21 two-observation NEW count vectors. Compute exact reset/stay likelihood ratio separately for repeated and distinct observed target categories. Independently verify closed-form inequality and posterior threshold. No RNG, original seed or experimental run.
control: Analytic bound must agree with exhaustive integer enumeration, old/new mass conservation counts, and the frozen earlier result candidate_changed==0 in all 36 worlds (audit file readback only, no original source execution).

acceptance.pass: Exact enumeration yields max Bayes factor 15/2 and max reset posterior 5/7; all 9702 cases have reset posterior<4/5; there is at least one attainable max case; original recorded worlds have candidate_changed==0; frozen source and result identities checked.
acceptance.invalid: Any prior/quota/source mismatch, algebra disagreement, frozen original result changed or original primary seeds replayed.
acceptance.impact: Falsifies scientific interpretation of a functioning adaptive local repair in ENERGY-REMAP-11. A baseline equivalent to MAP pooled is expected. No scientific gain by this proof itself.

sequence: Commit prereg first, then executable certificate source, byte-for-byte GitHub readback, one deterministic enumeration, result and read-only audit on same draft PR #1346. Do not mutate prior prereg/source/results.
